q: Menurut bab ini, mesin membantu kita untuk:
c: Bekerja dengan lebih cepat dan mudah
e: Introduction: machine operation – using mechanical equipment for cutting, shaping, lifting, pressing, assembling; machines help us work faster and easier.

q: Seksyen 15(2)(b) OSHA berkaitan operasi mesin menghendaki majikan:
c: Membuat pengaturan bagi operasi, pengendalian, penyimpanan dan pengangkutan loji dan bahan
e: Section 15(2): (a) provide and maintain plant and safe system of work; (b) arrangements for operation, handling, storage and transportation of plant and substances.

q: Kaedah pencegahan yang berkaitan pengurusan termasuk:
c: Merangka Dasar Keselamatan dan Kesihatan serta penyeliaan yang betul
e: Prevention: formulate Safety and Health Policy, proper supervision, training on safe handling, install safety warning signages.

q: Penyediaan senarai semak pemeriksaan (inspection checklist) termasuk dalam:
e: Prevention: prepare SOP, inspect machinery before use, prepare inspection checklist, formulate safety regulations, change work methods.

q: Menyediakan skrin pengadang mesin dan program penyelenggaraan pencegahan adalah:
e: Prevention: implement preventive maintenance programme, provide screen guard for machines, regular inspections of workplace environment.

q: Sebelum operasi (pre-operation), pekerja perlu:
c: Membaca dan memahami manual mesin serta arahan keselamatan
e: Pre-operation: pre-use inspection, wear PPE, read and understand manuals & safety instructions, ensure workspace clean.

q: Melaraskan tetapan seperti kelajuan, tekanan dan kedalaman potongan dilakukan pada peringkat:
e: Machine setup: adjust settings (speed, pressure, cutting depth), secure work piece, perform a test run.

q: Semasa operasi, pekerja perlu peka terhadap:
c: Bunyi luar biasa, getaran atau pemanasan berlebihan
e: Safe operation: trained and authorised, follow SOP, keep hands/hair/clothing away, don't bypass guards, stay alert to unusual noises, vibrations, overheating.

q: Kerosakan atau kecacatan mesin yang dikesan semasa penutupan perlu:
e: Shutdown: switch off and disconnect power, clean machine and area, report malfunctions or defects immediately.

q: Pada peringkat penyelenggaraan, pembaikan mesin hanya boleh dikendalikan oleh:
e: Maintenance: routine cleaning and servicing; only authorised personnel handle repairs; keep a maintenance logbook.

q: Faktor manusia bagi operasi mesin selamat termasuk operator yang:
c: Sihat dari segi fizikal dan mental serta kompeten
e: Human factors: experienced, trained, physically and mentally fit, competent, age 16 years and above.

q: Butang kawalan yang direka secara ergonomik ialah contoh faktor:
e: Machinery factors: stability, free from vibration, speed control, sturdy structure, guards, ergonomically designed control button, safe design.

q: Barang kemas atau pakaian longgar yang tersangkut pada bahagian berputar ialah bahaya mekanikal jenis:
e: Mechanical hazards: entanglement (loose clothing, jewelry, hair), crushing, shearing/cutting, impact.

q: Sentuhan dengan wayar hidup atau sambungan rosak boleh menyebabkan:
c: Kejutan, lecur atau renjatan elektrik maut
e: Electrical hazards: contact with live wires or faulty connections can cause shocks, burns or electrocution.

q: Mesin yang menghasilkan haba, percikan atau bahan lebur boleh menyebabkan bahaya:
e: Thermal hazards: machines that generate heat, sparks or molten material can cause burns; hot surfaces, steam, friction.

q: Pendedahan berpanjangan kepada aras bunyi tinggi daripada mesin boleh menyebabkan:
e: Noise and vibration: prolonged high noise exposure can cause hearing loss; continuous vibration may lead to HAVS or fatigue.

q: Cecair, gas mudah terbakar atau percikan dari mesin boleh mencetuskan bahaya:
e: Fire and explosion hazards: flammable liquids, gases or sparks from machines can ignite if safety measures are ignored.

q: Dalam kes mesin penghancur tebu di Ipoh (28 Januari 2025), kecederaan mangsa ialah:
c: Patah tulang berbilang dari pergelangan tangan hingga siku
e: Sugar crusher: foreign worker's hand caught, multiple fractures from wrist to elbow; factors – lack of guarding, unsafe use, poor training, inadequate supervision.

q: Punca utama kes mesin pengering pasir di Miri termasuk:
c: Ketiadaan sistem kerja selamat dan LOTO semasa penyelenggaraan
e: Miri 30 Aug 2024: lack of safe work system for maintenance around pulleys and belts, inadequate guarding, no lock-out/tag-out or isolation.

q: Dalam kes forklift di Kuching (16 Mac 2025), mangsa tersepit antara:
e: Kuching: 70-year-old driver pinned between pallet stacks and the forklift's fork; fork hit his left chest – tight working spaces, lack of barriers.
